templates.title: Mobility flow
templates.summary: Full-body mobility — vagal down-regulation and tissue health

main.detail: Flow: cat-cow, downward dog, low lunge, warrior II, hip opener, supine twist. Hold 4–6 breaths. Skip loaded spinal flexion if back is irritable.

cooldown.detail: Legs up the wall 2 min. Savasana 2 min.

templates.title: Pre-run mobility
templates.summary: Hip and ankle prep before running

main.detail: Leg swings front/back and side/side 10 each. World's greatest stretch 5/side. Ankle circles, calf raises 2 × 10. 2 × 20 m strides optional.

cooldown.detail: Shake out legs. Start your run within 5 min.

templates.title: Post-ride hip release
templates.summary: Hip flexor and thoracic mobility after cycling

warmup.detail: Easy walk 2 min off the bike.

main.detail: Kneeling hip flexor stretch 45 s/side; pigeon 45 s/side; thoracic rotations 10/side; doorway pec stretch 45 s; hamstring stretch 45 s. Foam roll quads and glutes 2 min.

templates.title: Swim shoulder mobility
templates.summary: Shoulder health for swimmers — rotator cuff and thoracic

main.detail: Band pull-aparts 3 × 15; wall slides 3 × 10; sleeper stretch 45 s/side; lat stretch 45 s/side; thoracic extension over foam roller 10 reps; doorway stretch 45 s.

cooldown.detail: Easy arm swings. No heavy loading after.

templates.title: Restorative yoga
templates.summary: Parasympathetic recovery — low nervous system load

main.detail: Supported child's pose 3 min; supine twist 2 min/side; legs up the wall 5 min; reclined butterfly 3 min. No binds or deep folds.

templates.title: Lower-body stretch
templates.summary: Static stretching — hip, hamstring, calf focus

main.detail: Hold 45–60 s each: calf (straight and bent knee), hamstring, hip flexor, pigeon, figure-4, 90/90 hips. Breathe into the stretch — no bouncing.
Doorway pec stretch 45 s; lat stretch 45 s/side; neck gentle rotations; thoracic rotations 10/side; wrist flexor/extensor stretch 30 s each.

templates.title: Ankle mobility
templates.summary: Dorsiflexion for runners — stride efficiency and injury prevention

main.detail: Knee-to-wall test and drill 3 × 10/side; calf stretch on step 45 s/side; banded ankle mobilization 2 × 15; toe yoga 2 × 10. Test dorsiflexion before and after.

templates.title: Thoracic spine mobility
templates.summary: T-spine rotation — swimming, cycling, and desk posture

main.detail: Quadruped thoracic rotations 10/side; open book 10/side; foam roller thoracic extension 10 reps; thread-the-needle 8/side; wall angels 3 × 10.

templates.title: Recovery day mobility
templates.summary: Full rest optional mobility — no training load

main.detail: 5 min easy walk. 10 min gentle mobility: hip circles, ankle circles, cat-cow, supine twist. Foam roll 5 min if desired. No training load.
